autoBackup.title: Periodic automatic backup
autoBackup.webOnly: Built-in automatic backup is only available in the installed Android app. In the browser, use the “Download backup file” option above.
autoBackup.description: In addition to manual backups, the app can automatically keep backup copies in its own storage, without any action from you, so your data is not lost after a crash or sudden shutdown. This works fully offline.
autoBackup.whereTitle: Where exactly are automatic backup files stored?
autoBackup.whereIntro: Each automatic backup is saved in two copies at the same time:
autoBackup.internalCopy: Internal copy (private to the app) — stored in the app's own storage, not visible in the phone's file manager. This copy can be picked from the list below for “quick restore”.
autoBackup.visibleCopyAfter: in the phone storage, which can be seen and copied with any file manager app (for example to move to another phone or upload to Google Drive). Copies older than {{days}} days are deleted from this path automatically.
autoBackup.lastFailed: The last automatic backup attempt failed
autoBackup.overdue: It has been longer than usual since the last successful automatic backup. Use the “Create internal backup now” button below to make a fresh copy and make sure everything works.
autoBackup.emptyList: No automatic backup has been created yet.
autoBackup.footerNote: The internal files (above) are for quick restore inside this app. To move to another phone or upload to cloud storage, use the visible copy at the path mentioned above, or the “Download backup file” option in the previous section.
autoBackup.restoreDialogDescription: All current app data will be replaced with the contents of the backup from {{date}}. This cannot be undone.
autoBackup.deleteDialogDescription: The backup from {{date}} will be permanently deleted.
autoBackup.toastRestored: Restore completed successfully. The app will reload...

page.standardHoursDescription: This number is used to convert the daily base wage into an hourly rate. For example, if the daily base wage is {{exampleWage}} and the standard work hours are {{exampleHours}}, the hourly rate is calculated as {{exampleRate}}.

page.backupDescription: Because this app is fully offline and data is stored only on this phone, use this option to download a backup file periodically to avoid losing data (for example when changing phones). The backup file is always stored encrypted; opening it directly (for example in a text editor) does not reveal the data.
page.exportPasswordHelperSet: This same password is required to restore this file on any device — write it down somewhere safe.

page.restoreWarning: Restoring from a backup file erases all current data (workers, attendance, photos and accounts) and replaces it with the file's contents. This cannot be undone.
page.confirmRestore: Restoring from a backup erases and replaces all current app data. Continue?
